# `source.pause`

Pause a source (reversible; per-source off switch).

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice source-pause`
- **MCP tool:** `source_pause` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_id` | `str` | required |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice source-pause --source-id src_abc123
```
